# Bar Freezer Australia

> Australian online store for commercial and home bar freezers, bar fridges, wine fridges, kegerators, ice machines, accessories and spare parts, delivered Australia-wide.

1538 products from 22 brands. Prices are in AUD and include GST. Orders are placed as order requests; payment instructions are emailed after stock and freight are confirmed. Accepted payment methods: Osko and cryptocurrency (BTC, USDT on Tron, ETH).
